result.title: Zero-Query Transferable Pretend Benign Attacks with Amortized Online Generation for Cooperative Perception
result.summary: Cooperative perception enables an ego agent to acquire information from collaborators beyond its own sensors' reach. Yet, the most beneficial messages are often the hardest to verify from local observations. Pretend Benign (PB) exploits this asymmetry by targeting regions with weak local verifiability and applying multi-objective perturbations, making harmful feature changes appear to be benign assistance. However, PB is victim-dependent: selecting regions and optimizing perturbations require the victim model's architecture, parameters, and gradients, limiting transfer to unseen victims. A transferable attack must capture properties shared across cooperative detection models rather than those specific to one network. We address this by building a victim-agnostic attack from a heterogeneous ensemble of surrogate models and encoding its capabilities in a reusable dictionary to reduce per-message generation cost. Specifically, Transferable Pretend Benign (TrPB) transfers PB's region selection criterion and multi-objective perturbation strategy across heterogeneous surrogates to construct an offline attack. We further propose RT-TrPB, which encodes transferable regions and perturbation patterns into a region predictor and reusable perturbation dictionary, amortizing per-message attack generation. Experiments on widely used cooperative perception benchmarks show that RT-TrPB bypasses the consensus-based defenses ROBOSAC and FLD with success rates approaching 100% and generates each perturbation in under 56 ms. To counter PB-style attacks masquerading as benign collaboration, we also propose STTrust, which verifies received messages using spatial and temporal consistency and incorporates identity-level trust. STTrust detects over 90% of PB-style attacks and restores perception performance to near the attack-free level.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究协同感知中的「伪装良性」迁移攻击：用异构替代模型集成把区域选择与多目标扰动策略变为与受害者无关的离线攻击，并提出 RT-TrPB 用区域预测器和可复用扰动字典摊销每条消息的生成成本，同时给出基于时空一致性与身份信任的防御 STTrust。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把逐样本优化摊销为预测器 + 可复用字典」的在线生成思路，可能为 LVR 中低成本产生并复用 latent 推理状态提供方法线索；攻击侧重「局部可验证性弱的区域」也可供核查，但距离视觉推理主线较远，需较多核实。
